channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Tiffany McGhee Says Earnings Must Show AI Spending Is Paying Off
item.description: Tiffany McGhee, CEO and CIO of Pivotal Advisors, described the market as resilient but still sensitive to interest rates. Ahead of earnings season, which begins Tuesday the 13th, she said investors will focus on whether companies can demonstrate monetization of their AI investments, as well as whether geopolitical tensions are affecting individual businesses. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: C.H. Robinson CEO Dave Bozeman on RXO $5.8B Acquisition
item.description: C.H. Robinson is set to acquire RXO’s trucking brokerage business in a deal valued at about $5.8 billion. CEO and President Dave Bozeman said the combination would bring together C.H. Robinson’s global multimodal, freight brokerage and forwarding operations with RXO’s North American brokerage, last-mile and expedited services. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: VivaTech x Bloomberg Awards Ceremony
item.description: The inaugural VivaTech x Bloomberg Awards ceremony, hosted by Bloomberg Television’s Francine Lacqua and Tom Mackenzie, was held on June 18, 2026, at the VivaTech conference in Paris, celebrating seven global leaders and innovators shaping the future of technology. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI in $30 Billion Round Talks With UAE Funds, BlackRock
item.description: OpenAI is in talks with multiple investment funds from the United Arab Emirates, including Abu Dhabi-based MGX, to help anchor a $30 billion round of financing for the ChatGPT maker, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Ed Ludlow, Rebecca Torrence, Shirin Ghaffary and Natasha Mascarenhas

item.title: Singapore’s DayOne Files for US IPO Joining AI Data Center Rush
item.description: DayOne Data Centers Ltd. filed for a US initial public offering, setting the Singapore-headquartered firm up to capture investors’ resilient demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Anthony Hughes

item.title: Amazon Executive to Join Pinterest as Chief Financial Officer
item.description: Pinterest Inc. has appointed Amazon veteran James Dibbo to lead its finance team as the platform works to reposition itself as a creative alternative to other social media sites.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra S. Levine

item.title: Nvidia enfrenta preguntas sobre contrabando de chips de IA en China
item.description: Los chips de IA de la empresa siguen llegando a China a pesar de las restricciones estadounidenses. Las autoridades se preguntan por qué la empresa no detectó las señales de alerta.
item.dc:creator: Mackenzie Hawkins

item.title: Allan Gray Favors Office REITs as Market Overplays AI Threat
item.description: Allan Gray Australia Ltd. is favoring stocks related to beaten-down office landlords, expecting the sector to rebound as investors overestimate the threat artificial intelligence poses to demand for office space.
item.dc:creator: Joe Flynn

item.title: San Diego Sues AppLovin Over Explicit Ads Shown to Kids’ Devices
item.description: San Diego County has filed a lawsuit against mobile advertising technology company AppLovin Corp., alleging that it bypassed parental controls to serve ads for adult dating services, alcohol, vaping and graphic sexual content in games played by children.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Solon

item.title: Nvidia-Backed Reflection Unveils Open AI Model, Taking on China
item.description: Reflection AI, an artificial intelligence startup from two former Google DeepMind researchers, has unveiled a new open-weight model that it says rivals leading options in the US and China.
item.dc:creator: Shirin Ghaffary and Natasha Mascarenhas

item.title: 'Blue Horseshoe': Tracking 'Big Active'
item.description: Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas discuss the new Bloomberg Intelligence tool 'Blue Horseshoe' on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." The new "Blue Horseshoe" tool lets Bloomberg Terminal users see which stocks the biggest active managers ('Big Active') are buying and selling every day on an aggregate basis. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Spending Rolls On as Tech Wealth Hits Records
item.description: Companies are spending billions on AI, but actually getting it into production remains a major challenge. Insight Partners sees forward-deployed engineers as part of the solution: embedding directly with customers to turn AI into working products and workflows. Insight Partners Operating Partner Pablo Dominguez joins to discuss why the firm is launching a dedicated practice to help its portfolio companies build that capability. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Apple New CEO Ternus Puts Focus Back on Design
item.description: Apple's new CEO is putting his own stamp on the company and making design a much bigger priority. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman discusses how John Ternus is taking a hands-on role as Apple prepares a wave of new products in this week's Power On newsletter - also now a podcast. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI ‘Pacing’ Doesn’t Mean Slower Adoption
item.description: NEA partner Tiffany Luck says any slowdown in development at the AI frontier doesn’t have to slow adoption across the economy. She argues increasingly powerful models from OpenAI, Anthropic and others are already well ahead of enterprise deployment, leaving a major opportunity for companies that can turn raw intelligence into real-world workflows and measurable returns. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Moves From Experiment to the Enterprise
item.description: Companies are spending billions on AI, but actually getting it into production remains a major challenge. Insight Partners sees forward-deployed engineers as part of the solution: embedding directly with customers to turn AI into working products and workflows. Insight Partners Operating Partner Pablo Dominguez joins to discuss why the firm is launching a dedicated practice to help its portfolio companies build that capability. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: BofA Sees the End of ‘Easy Money’ Made From the AI-Spending Trade
item.description: Investors are likely to find it increasingly hard to make “easy money” by betting on outsized returns from artificial intelligence-linked capital expenditures compared with consumer-driven spending, according to strategists at Bank of America Corp.
item.dc:creator: Felice Maranz

item.title: CH Robinson to Buy RXO for $5.8B in Bet on AI Model
item.description: CH Robinson agreed to buy trucking brokerage firm RXO Inc. in a deal centered around a bet that artificial intelligence can help the companies improve efficiency in a challenging freight market. Through a cash-and-stock transaction valued at about $5.8 billion, CH Robinson aims to diversify its business and capitalize on RXO’s abilities in expedited and last-mile delivery. CH Robinson, which has been using AI to transform its operations to become leaner, intends to use the system to extract $300 million of cost savings within two years. Lee Klaskow, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Transport, Logistics and Shipping Analyst says that the $300 million estimate could be conservative. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Gas Prices May Cause Consumers to Be 'Edgy,' Kaiser Says
item.description: Stuart Kaiser, head of US equity trading strategy at Citigroup Global Markets, says higher gas prices are causing consumer be "edgy" as we get closer to the holiday season. He also expects CEOs to deliver bullish messages during earnings season. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic Can Keep Creating Value After IPO: Fanari
item.description: Maggie Fanari, chief executive officer of J. Rothschild Capital Management and an Anthropic investor, says the AI company can continue creating value after going public as it compounds growth over the long term. She also views Anthropic’s focus on AI safety as a strength, arguing that technological development and safeguards need to advance together. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Ex-Anthropic Researcher Jacob Coxon Testifies at NYC Council AI Hearing
item.description: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon warned that the race to develop artificial intelligence poses risks that the industry itself doesn’t fully understand, at a New York City Council hearing where lawmakers weighed whether to impose their own safeguards on a burgeoning global business.
item.dc:creator: Nacha Cattan and Laura Nahmias
